unlisted_practices: Inference-aware LLM-as-judge evaluation with calibrated prompting and medical ontology retrieval grounding to reduce false hallucination flags in SOAP note evaluation

screen.reason: The study empirically tests and compares evaluation/auditing practices for medical SOAP note generation, contrasting standard lexical faithfulness checks against inference-aware evaluation grounded in medical ontologies to properly detect genuine safety risks versus valid clinical inferences.

primary.practice: ontology-grounded and inference-aware evaluation/guardrail prompts for hallucination detection
